[NCBK.4.1] Operational events operators want to see — distinct from
`ds_result_t` errors (which travel as return values). Two sources flow through
this callback: engine-internal logs (wm, schema, dispatcher) and rule-author
`log` actions. They share one shape; the `category` string is the convention
that distinguishes them.

The callback type is `ds_log_cb_t`, its payload `ds_log_event_t`, and it is registered by `ds_engine_set_log_callback` — all declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
